limitations: n3 repeats the same fixture with completed history and warm filesystem; first activation remains n1. No statistical stability, confidence interval or p95 is inferred.
Baseline/current order was fixed. OS idleness, unrelated background load and cache effects were not measured.
Instrumented absolute API durations include observer overhead. Clock-only measurements are separate; the interrupted quiet-window candidate cannot quantify comparative overhead.

Filesystem bytes are known payload counters at JS API boundaries, not total logical copy traffic or physical IO. Native copyFile returns void and records0 unknown payload; Git checkout-index writes bypass the JS observer.
Journal bytes include journal.json/events.log/events.tip and corresponding owned temporaries. File sync counts and awaited durations are separate from directory persistence and power-loss guarantees.
Method phases are inclusive and overlap; phase times and nested fs API times must not be added.
RSS includes the worker/harness, omits child Git RSS and sub10ms peaks; no RSS measurement exists in clock-only cases.

Endpoint allocated file-data bytes use unique dev:ino and Stats.blocks*512 on the verified runtime. They exclude directories,MFT,ADS,CoW unique extents,device IO and peak usage. Resident small files may report0 allocation while MFT cost remains unmeasured.
Git counters cover direct observed spawn attempts/processes only; descendants are unobserved. No actual process identifiers or host paths are published.
Performance-fixture native oracles do not certify the final product or replace the final functional suites.
